exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI (normal weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: 604 Chinese women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed between January 2010 and December 2011
finding: Overweight and obese women with GDM have an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including pre-eclampsia and cesarean section, compared to normal weight women with GDM.
mod_finding: Obese women with GDM were at increased risk of caesarean section compared with normal weight and overweight women with GDM.
